items.title: Orrin Keepnews interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: I got a call from a New Yorker writer, Adam Gopnick. I was interviewed

ctx.x: Ahmad Jamal feeling positive about Bill Evans. Well the nice thing see about going out after those quotes, it so happens I got four quotes out of four people. But if it had taken eight or ten people to come up with the four good quotes nobody would have known that when the record came out. But those were the only four people, and as I say Miles’ quote was in existence. Getting a quote from him might have been another whole thing but I didn’t have to. I just would say Miles I’m going to use this, okay? And I…

anniversary of that recording, I got a call from a New Yorker writer, Adam Gopnick. I was interviewed, Paul was interviewed, Lorraine Gordon, who incidentally is the woman who I obliquely referred to under her first married name, the woman who was originally married to Alfred Lion at Blue Note ended up being married to the widower and now, for a number of years the owner of the Village Vanguard. So Lorraine was the best they could do in terms of dealing with the Vanguard thing. So I got to be quoted in the New…

My favorite musician actually, ever, is Cannonball and Nat. Actually I think of them together an awful lot. And I wanted to play something if I could, from amongst the things that you had a hand in, and maybe you can just tell me about what you think about him as a person. Let’s see if I can find it here.
